reviewers.summary: The change implements the specified technical mode outcomes and component scoping, but an unavailable mode on another source can suppress a technical stale or conflict finding.

findingList.message: Gather available technical records independently of other sources’ unavailable modes, or preserve the technical mode outcome when gathering is skipped. An unavailable mode for another source currently masks stale or conflicting technical evidence.

evidence.codePathTraced: Assess skips gathering every source when any mode is unavailable. It then calls SourceModeFindingPolicy.Assess with no pins; stale and conflicting technical modes only produce a reason when relevant technical records are present.
evidence.failureScenario: If technical mode is stale or conflicting while finance mode is unavailable, a document-witnessed engine claim is assessed with no technical pins. The technical failure is not detected, so the finding can follow the normal path instead of routing to Review with source_stale or source_conflict.

reviewers.summary: The named tests cover the mode outcomes, Case B routing, and revision-conflict behavior. The conflicting-read test does not verify that the alternate record preserves the entire payload.

findingList.message: Assert that the complete payload is identical for the original and alternate records; checking only serialNumber does not verify the conflicting-read payload criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: The conflicting-mode test compares only the serialNumber field of the original and alternate records.
evidence.failureScenario: If the alternate record changes another payload field, such as position, while preserving serialNumber, this assertion still passes although the acceptance criterion requires the same payload.

reviewers.summary: No security vulnerabilities found in the changed code. Source reads remain behind authentication, case-scope, role, and read-budget checks; the new mode handling uses the authorized case state and does not execute or interpolate assessment input.
